title: firewall
description: The input filter of the guest (D-295, D-300): the agent owns exactly one nftables table, inet plumb, with one input chain, and replaces it atomically (nft -f). Other tables are never read or changed; drift is a change to this table only. One per Target: the key name is always main. The table always accepts, before every rule: loopback, established and related packets (the agent link is outbound), ICMPv6 neighbor discovery and router advertisements, and DHCPv6 replies (udp 546 from fe80::/10). The SSH port stays open (from ssh_sources, empty = from everywhere) unless allow_no_ssh is true; the Plan shows the effective SSH rule. No output or forward chain. Known limits: ports that Docker publishes go through forward and are not filtered; with policy drop, traffic from a Docker bridge (docker0, br-*) to a service of the guest itself is dropped unless its port is listed. Needs the package nftables (nft). Safe apply (D-293): the agent keeps the confirmed rules and puts them back when it gets no fresh controller round trip within 90 s. Risk: create and change disruptive; absent removes the table (disruptive).

name.description: Always main: a Target has one firewall.

policy.description: What happens to an input packet that no rule accepts.

tcp_ports.description: TCP ports to accept, comma separated, ranges as a-b, for example 80,443,8000-8100. A text, so a Block parameter can fill it. The agent checks every value before it changes anything (each port 1 … 65535, a range goes up); a bad value fails the step and leaves the guest as it was.

udp_ports.description: UDP ports to accept, in the form of tcp_ports.

sources.description: Source networks for tcp_ports and udp_ports, comma separated CIDRs (IPv4 with prefix 0 … 32, IPv6 0 … 128; the agent checks it before any change). Empty: from everywhere.

ssh_port.description: The SSH port. The table always accepts TCP to it (from ssh_sources), whatever the policy, so a firewall change cannot lock out SSH by accident (D-295, D-300). Default 22: when a Block moves sshd to another port, set the same port here, or SSH is closed.

ssh_sources.description: Source networks for the SSH port, in the form of sources. Empty: from everywhere.

allow_no_ssh.description: true: no SSH rule. With policy drop and no rule for the SSH port, only the console reaches the guest. The Plan shows this attribute. ssh_port and ssh_sources must then be missing.

ping.description: Accept ICMP and ICMPv6 echo requests.

state.description: absent: the agent deletes the table inet plumb and its boot file; the other attributes must then be missing.
